description: Black and white full length portrait of Todd Webb standing against the black wooden door of the Salita, posing in the doorway, smiling with one leg bent in front of the other.  He wears a light colored shirt with rolled sleeves, light colored slacks, and dark moccasin loafers and a watch.. He has a light meter cord around his neck and into his pocket.  Surrounded by the exterior adobe wall, one arm and hand is leaning against the doorway and his other hand is at his side holding a cigarette.
title: Untitled ( Todd Webb in the Salita Door ), Abiquiu
